title: Implement optional research adapter and reference symbol declarations
description:
Implement the optional research data layer.

mike_trade/research/ports.py:
- Define a ResearchDataProvider port (Protocol/ABC) and immutable research records.
- Each record carries: input key, symbol, value, source, publication_ts, observed_ts, ingestion_ts (all timezone-aware UTC), revision id/number, freshness/max-age, a missing flag with reason, and licensing/usage metadata.
- Define a strategy research-requirement declaration: input key, mandatory vs optional, maximum age, and per-symbol applicability.

mike_trade/research/service.py:
- Implement ResearchService, which builds research context for strategy evaluation.
- Fetch only the inputs that registered strategies declare as required for the watched symbols. Fetch each (symbol, input key) once per refresh cycle, shared across strategies and scenarios.
- Cache with a bounded size.
- Expose an immutable ResearchContext. When a mandatory input is missing or stale, the context reports no-signal-permitted for that strategy/symbol, with a reason code. Optional missing inputs are surfaced as missing without blocking.
- Provide a built-in NullResearchProvider, the default, which requires no paid provider, no network access, and no manual upload. Basic operation must work with no research configured.
- Provide reference symbol declarations: a small, documented declaration helper, plus example declarations showing how a strategy declares research inputs. vwap_reference declares none.

Strategies receive only ResearchContext and never the provider.

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/market_data/service.py and mike_trade/market_data/cache.py (g.3) for the shared-fetch and immutable-snapshot patterns to mirror
- mike_trade/market_data/quality.py (g.4) for freshness/reason-code conventions
- mike_trade/ strategy base/registry and domain modules from earlier phases (if present)
acceptance_criteria: mike_trade/research/ports.py defines a ResearchDataProvider port and frozen research record types. The records include source, publication_ts, observed_ts, ingestion_ts, revision, freshness/max-age, missing flag/reason, and licensing fields, and every timestamp is timezone-aware UTC.
ResearchService requests only the inputs declared by registered strategies; a test with a fake provider asserts that undeclared inputs are never requested.
When two strategies and two scenarios declare the same (symbol, input), the provider is called once per refresh cycle; a test counts the calls.
When a mandatory input is missing or older than its maximum age, ResearchContext reports no-signal-permitted with a reason code; a negative test covers both the missing and the stale case.
A missing optional input is marked missing but does not block signal permission; a test covers this.

With no research configured, the default NullResearchProvider lets ResearchService run without network access, paid providers, or files, and strategies that declare no inputs are unaffected; a test covers this.
Strategy-facing ResearchContext objects are immutable and expose no provider or network handle; a test verifies this.
The reference declaration helper and example declarations exist, and vwap_reference is documented as declaring no research inputs.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
require a paid research provider or manual upload for basic operation
expose research providers or network clients to strategies
use network access or real credentials in tests
run broad test suites or backtests
